text:
Ross Perot finished with about 19% of the popular vote in the 1992 election, roughly 19.7 million votes, and won no electoral votes. The 39% figure was his June 1992 Gallup poll lead, and his support dropped after he left the race in July and re-entered in October. The team note's options were 19 and 7, and 19 is the one that matches.

CONFIDENCE: 97
